name: In a Pickle
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough
description: A soot-blackened brazier glows with fiendish light, shadows fickering inside.
disable: DC 18 Arcana , DC 18 Occultism , or DC 18 Religion while within 15 feet of the brazier to command it to stop, reducing its actions by 1 (or 2 on a critical success); DC 20 Thievery to fnd the hidden switch on the brazier that deactivates it; or 1st-rank spell, counteract DC 17, to dispel the shadow flames in one square, using any spell with the water or light traits.
reset: The flames cease 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area, but after 1 hour, a well of darkness fills the brazier and it is ready to trigger again.
routine: (4 actions) The trap ignites shadowy flames in a 5-foot square within the area of the room A creature that moves into or ends its turn in this fire takes (1d6+5) Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw) Increase the DC by 2 if the creature is in magical darkness (Basic DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw).

offensiveAbilities.name: Flames of Caina
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the area

Effect Shadows roil in the brazier. It casts Darkness on itself, and then rolls initiative.
